mapper.select: SELECT p.code, p.name, p.name_en, p.full_name, p.region, p.latitude, p.longitude, p.area_km2, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wards w WHERE w.province_code = p.code AND w.is_active = TRUE) AS ward_count, ST_YMin(p.bbox) AS min_lat, ST_XMin(p.bbox) AS min_lng, ST_YMax(p.bbox) AS max_lat, ST_XMax(p.bbox) AS max_lng, (p.geom IS NOT NULL) AS has_boundary FROM provinces p WHERE p.is_active = TRUE ORDER BY p.code

SELECT json_build_object( 'type', 'FeatureCollection', 'features', json_agg(json_build_object( 'type', 'Feature', 'id', p.code, 'properties', json_build_object('code', p.code, 'name', p.name, 'nameEn', p.name_en), 'geometry', ST_AsGeoJSON(p.geom_display, 4)::json) ORDER BY p.code))::text FROM provinces p WHERE p.is_active = TRUE AND p.geom_display IS NOT NULL HAVING COUNT(*) > 0

SELECT version, decree, generated_at AS generatedAt, imported_at AS importedAt, backfilled_at AS backfilledAt, province_count AS provinceCount, ward_count AS wardCount FROM geo_dataset_versions ORDER BY imported_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE geo_dataset_versions SET backfilled_at = now() WHERE version = #{version}
mapper.sql: SELECT r.old_code FROM province_code_remap r WHERE r.new_code <> r.old_code AND r.old_code NOT IN (SELECT new_code FROM province_code_remap)
mapper.select: SELECT p.code, p.name, p.aliases::text AS aliases, r.new_code FROM provinces p JOIN province_code_remap r ON r.old_code = p.code WHERE p.code IN () ORDER BY p.code
mapper.update: UPDATE provinces SET aliases = (SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(DISTINCT alias), '[]'::jsonb) FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(aliases, '[]'::jsonb) || #{aliases}::jsonb) alias) WHERE code = #{code}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO passport_definition_provinces (passport_id, province_code) SELECT d.passport_id, r.new_code FROM passport_definition_provinces d JOIN province_code_remap r ON r.old_code = d.province_code WHERE d.province_code IN () ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM passport_definition_provinces WHERE province_code IN ()

mapper.delete: DELETE FROM passport_province_wishes WHERE province_code IN ()

UPDATE places p SET ward_code = w.code, province_code = w.province_code FROM wards w WHERE p.latitude IS NOT NULL AND p.longitude IS NOT NULL AND (p.ward_code IS NULL OR #{force}) AND w.is_active = TRUE AND ST_Covers(w.geom, )

UPDATE user_checkins p SET ward_code = w.code, province_code = w.province_code FROM wards w WHERE p.latitude IS NOT NULL AND p.longitude IS NOT NULL AND (p.ward_code IS NULL OR #{force}) AND w.is_active = TRUE AND ST_Covers(w.geom, )

UPDATE passport_events e SET ward_code = c.ward_code, province_code = COALESCE(c.province_code, e.province_code) FROM user_checkins c WHERE c.id = e.checkin_id AND c.ward_code IS NOT NULL AND e.ward_code IS DISTINCT FROM c.ward_code

UPDATE passport_events p SET ward_code = w.code, province_code = w.province_code FROM wards w WHERE p.checkin_id IS NULL AND p.ward_code IS NULL AND p.latitude IS NOT NULL AND p.longitude IS NOT NULL AND w.is_active = TRUE AND ST_Covers(w.geom, )

UPDATE activity_bookings a SET ward_code = w.code, province_code = w.province_code FROM wards w WHERE a.search_lat IS NOT NULL AND a.search_lng IS NOT NULL AND (a.ward_code IS NULL OR #{force}) AND w.is_active = TRUE AND ST_Covers(w.geom, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(a.search_lng, a.search_lat), 4326))
UPDATE hotel_profiles hp SET ward_code = p.ward_code, province_code = p.province_code FROM places p WHERE p.id = hp.place_id AND p.ward_code IS NOT NULL AND (hp.ward_code IS NULL OR #{force})

UPDATE trips t SET ward_code = w.code, province_code = w.province_code FROM wards w WHERE t.destination_lat IS NOT NULL AND t.destination_lng IS NOT NULL AND (t.ward_code IS NULL OR #{force}) AND w.is_active = TRUE AND ST_Covers(w.geom, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(t.destination_lng::float8, t.destination_lat::float8), 4326))

UPDATE trip_destinations d SET ward_code = w.code, province_code = w.province_code FROM wards w WHERE d.lat IS NOT NULL AND d.lng IS NOT NULL AND (d.ward_code IS NULL OR #{force}) AND w.is_active = TRUE AND ST_Covers(w.geom, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(d.lng::float8, d.lat::float8), 4326))
